scar: A STATUS FILE WRITTEN AT LAUNCH IS A LAUNCH MARKER. Only a terminal record proves an end.
the_audit_was_wrong_three_times: 1) exit_code and status are FILES the wrapper writes, not metadata.json keys -- 33 completed lanes read as NO_EXIT_RECORDED. 2) superwave 1's receipt keys lanes by SHORT name in `lane` and full task id in `task`; the parser read `lane` and found 0 of 20 recorded. 3) the ledger's own lane TABLE is the largest disposition store -- twelve wave-2/3/4 lanes live there and nowhere else -- and reading only receipts reported all twelve as having no recorded cause. Every one of the three made the campaign look worse than it was, which is the safer direction to be wrong and still wrong.
two_bars_not_one: UNOBSERVED (no terminal record on disk at all) and NO_RECORDED_DISPOSITION (no cause). The loose bar alone is misleading: removing superwave 1's twenty dispositions left UNOBSERVED at 0, because those lanes carry exit codes. G010 asks for 'landed, rejected, or reaped WITH CAUSE', and an exit code is a number, not a cause.
